children: (NYSE: WKC), operating as World Fuel, announced today that its board of directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per share, which is payable on October 16, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 28, 2026.

Headquartered in Miami, Florida, we are a leading global provider of aviation, marine and ground-based transportation fuels and complementary services. Through an integrated global supply and logistics network, we source and distribute products and services to meet customer needs across more than 200 countries and territories throughout the world, including lower-carbon fuels to support customers' energy-transition objectives. In the United States, we also market natural gas and related solutions.
